snapshot.name: Polycab India Ltd
snapshot.about: Polycab is India’s leading manufacturers of cables and wires and allied products such as uPVC conduits and lugs and glands. We have a range of cables and wires for practically every application. More recently Polycab has also launched a wide range of consumer electrical products like Fans, Switches, Switchgear, LED lights and Luminaries, Solar Inverters, and Pumps.

latest_quarter.source: screener quarterly table (standardised from exchange filing)
latest_quarter.headline: Revenue +53% YoY, EBITDA +39%, PAT +43%, margin 14.4% (-1.4pp YoY)

notes.text: Capex in progress: CWIP is 35% of fixed assets — growth capacity not yet earning
Working capital tightening: cash conversion cycle 65 → 39 days
5-yr cumulative CFO is 1.01× PAT (₹8,856 Cr vs ₹8,756 Cr)
5-yr free cash flow ₹4,592 Cr; negative in 1 of 5 years

business_mix.what_it_does: Polycab India Limited engages in the manufacturing and selling of wires and cables, fast moving electrical goods (FMEG), and executing engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) projects.

segments.name: Wires and Cables
segments.note: Delivered strong growth with domestic wires and cables growing 50% year-on-year and exports growing 17% year-on-year.

segments.name: FMEG
segments.note: Fast Moving Electrical Goods segment registered 124% year-on-year growth driven heavily by solar products.

segments.name: EPC
segments.note: Reported revenues of INR 6,171 million representing a healthy year-on-year growth of 53%.
